items.quote: Two ways Dubai prop-tech startup ends in 2026. For B2B: you get two or three companies paying you for two, three months.
items.statement: For B2B, you get two or three companies paying you for two, three months.

items.quote: Then the guy inside who had your back leaves. The next one has no budget at all.
items.statement: In B2B, the next decision-maker often has no budget.

items.quote: No case studies, no sales process, no product.
items.statement: B2B operations can lack case studies and defined sales processes.

items.quote: For B2C: a lot of free users who open it twice, maybe some💰 for a month, then cancel.
items.statement: B2C often results in many free users who quickly disengage.

items.quote: And you’re staring at the thing you spent everything building.
items.statement: Startup founders can become frustrated seeing their efforts yield no profit.

overview: A commentary on challenges faced by a Dubai prop-tech startup with a focus on B2B and B2C models.
